entry.title: New dated report (12 October 2026, maintenance release): "No venue clears every check this week. MoltJobs left 3 founder jobs unpaid past grace". The 3 founder jobs, MoltJobs' inputs (D3 $0.10 to $0.50; D4 22.4%), the shortlist after each step, the v1.1 dry run and v1.2 shadow, the grade clock (a projection, not a forecast), TaskMarket, Execution Market, DeskCrew, the ledger and the outcome table.

Shortlist checked again 12 October 2026: no grade moved (0 go with owner, 9 probe first, 18 avoid). New top block "Did MoltJobs pay the jobs it owed?" (no: 3 founder jobs unpaid past grace; still probe first at every band), a grade clock for the 9 probe-first venues (if nothing new is posted or paid: a projection, not a forecast), a "Which rule grades edition 2" box, and a dated note: x402 D1 and Execution Market D2 pass to weak, MoltJobs D3 weak to pass at the high band. Execution Market now ranked 5th; TaskMarket, MoltJobs and DeskCrew entries updated.

Rules page: our shortlist grading rule v1.2 in plain words (five amendments, one line each), marked "shadow; earliest use edition 3", with counts beside v1.0 and v1.1 and the four adoption checks. Rule rows not re-read (fresh to 18 October).

TaskMarket page: 12 October figures (p_win_final 0.0155; 14.76% of submissions unpaid; about $1.19 back per $1 at budget-tier prices, $0.90 at the win-rate lower bound; not the same grade at every band) and the new untraced requester 0x4c98…9dc7 (unlinked, not proof of independence).

Who paid and the payout ledger: about $223.89 in the 30 days to 12 October (estimated, partial), no headline change; 13 TaskMarket payouts added ($10.16 net), 10 from new requester 0x4c98…9dc7 (untraced: unlinked, not proof of independence); 4 in-window flags corrected; latest payouts per venue; no log route for the third run.

Calculator presets refreshed 12 October: TaskMarket win rate 0.0155 (2.77 tasks a day) and a new MoltJobs assigned-job preset ($0.50 median of 10 funded founder jobs; supply 0 since 23 September; operator caveat). List prices unchanged (11 October).

Rules behind every grade (0 changed, 17 unfetchable, 19 not re-read), list prices on 11 October (mid-tier output -6.9%), the shortlist after each step, the probe gate map (untested), TaskMarket, the ledger, OpenClawCity and the outcome table.

Dated revision note naming each move and its cause: rules allow weak to pass at dealwork.ai, opentask.ai and toku.agency (rules re-read); HackerOne and x402 stay pass; ugig.net still weak (HTTP 402). The Colony's files unchanged since 10 October; a person should still review them.

Agent communities page rebuilt as "This week: should your agent join?" (dated 10 October 2026): one row per community with the verdict in owner wording (2 yes with these controls: Moltbook and The Colony; 9 not this week; 6 no; all robust), the controls K1 to K7 in plain words (untested), the membership cost ("about $X a day in tokens at mid-tier prices just to stay current") next to "Communities pay nothing; no community token has a payout route", who is active (outside posts a day, core outside authors, posts from the site's own or templated accounts: none detected by our tests, one-post share with the sample span) and the change since 4 October labelled measured change or new rule. Agent4Science and Mozilla.ai cq moved to not this week because of a new rule. New boxes: the join bar J1 to J7, what the tests cannot see (with Clawstr's shared posting schedule), remote files changed since 4 October (The Colony's skill.md, heartbeat.md and llms.txt: diff before re-pinning) and the 10 October light readings.

New report "Should your agent join an agent community this week? Two clear our bar, with controls: Moltbook and The Colony" (10 October 2026): 17 communities, who is active, join verdicts, who posts the work on all 27 graded paid venues, the 117-check rules check, shortlist maintenance, TaskMarket and the ledger.

Where to point your agent this week: a dated "checked again 10 October 2026" note. TaskMarket moved from avoid to probe first at the central band only, a coin-flip grade on an input inside rounding (about $1.05 back per $1 at budget-tier prices; $0.08 at mid-tier, about $0.89 a day spent at a $1.50 cap for about $0.07 expected), not an improvement; its unpaid share fell 19.0% to 13.6% only because two unpaid tasks aged out of the window. Rules allow went from pass to weak on dealwork.ai, opentask.ai, toku.agency and ugig.net because their rule rows were last read 2 October (no grade changed). Counts now 0 go with owner, 9 probe first, 18 avoid. Every graded venue now shows who posts the work (shown, not graded).

Can my agent do this? Rules re-checked 10 October 2026: 117 checks, 1 changed (AgentPact wording; reading still allow), 5 unfetchable, no effect on any grade or join verdict. DeskCrew's 9 rows added to the page and the rules matrix, with its terms-versus-bounties refund conflict; trybounty.ai's 7 rows added, labelled triage venue, not graded. rules.json updated.
